title: Admit M8 root milestone readiness through typed forward-only DWF transition after qualified Discovery handoff
commitMessage: chore: admit M8 milestone readiness for forward-only development

contribution.summary: Advance only the M8 native milestone from not-ready to ready after its completed M7 dependency, keeping all accepted child work pending.
contribution.value: Use the documented target-reentrant ProjectPlan.TransitionNode to make the M8 root eligible for a new bounded development cycle, supported by the preserved RS131/209 protocol evidence, RS279 source-free Windows consumer, RS281 portable exporter, RS282 Linux .NET 11 qualification and RS283 standalone unsigned integrity receipt. Align the native adoption validator and Discovery acceptance frontier with the exact one-node target; explicitly retain M8-W01/M8-W02 and all tasks not-ready, M9 not-ready, canonical backlog planned and no completion achievements.
debtChanges: The accepted M8 milestone has M7 done and independently qualified Discovery delivery evidence, but its native root still remained not-ready and could not be scheduled forward.
RS281 succeeded attempt 001 with three preselection refusals, not first-pass; RS282 and RS283 succeeded first-pass. None constitutes task-level RED/GREEN/verification completion.
The root readiness transition does not grant broker permission, install in AURA, migrate production packages, publish NuGet, or promote any child node or product release.
contribution.nextAction: Refine and admit one new M8-W01 task under its accepted RED/GREEN/verification contract, then earn actual forward-only lifecycle evidence before any task completion.
